Metadata.title: GitHub Profile Generator
Metadata.description: A visual way to tell your story on GitHub. Showcase your knowledge, education, projects and contributions with optional profile sections.

Home.title: A GitHub profile.
Home.description: Bring your knowledge, learning and work together. Choose the sections that tell your story, wherever you are in your journey.
Home.note: Explore the building blocks in this early preview. The profile editor is coming next.
Home.previewBio: I build thoughtful experiences for the web and mobile. Always curious about what comes next.
Home.previewCaption: One possible composition. Every section is a choice.
Home.principlesLabel: A place for every kind of developer
Home.principleThree: Your story can grow with you
Home.modulesTitle: Make room for what matters to you.
Home.modulesDescription: Start with a small introduction or give your work more context. These nine sections adapt to what you want to share.

presentation.title: A little about you
presentation.description: Your name, interests and a short introduction in your own words.

knowledge.title: What you know
knowledge.description: Describe the things you can do and the problems you like solving.

technologies.title: Technologies & tools
technologies.description: Group your tools and add context about how you use them.

education.title: Education & training
education.description: Make space for your degree, ongoing studies, courses and certifications.

current.title: Right now
current.description: Share what you are learning, building or looking to collaborate on.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.description: Show your work, explain your role and share what you learned.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Highlight meaningful improvements, reviews and collaborations.

metrics.title: GitHub activity
metrics.description: Choose the public activity and statistics you want to include.

contact.title: Let's connect
contact.description: Bring your portfolio, professional networks and contact links together.

Home.processTitle: A clear path to a profile that feels like you.

choose.title: Choose your focus
choose.description: Knowledge, projects, contributions — pick what you want to highlight.

compose.title: Tell your story
compose.description: Add the sections you need and complete them at your own pace.

personalize.title: Make it yours
personalize.description: Find an order and style that make your story easy to read.

Home.closingTitle: A little space. A better first impression.
Home.closingDescription: Clear content, purposeful details and a design that leaves room for you.
Home.footer: Built around people, at every stage.
Home.footerNote: Independent project. Not affiliated with GitHub.

NotFound.title: This page isn't here.
NotFound.description: The address may have changed. You can return to the home page and continue from there.
